records.title: Harbor planning note · assumptions and open dependencies
records.body:
PLANNING NOTE / REVISION 4

Purpose
This note assembles the evidence currently available for the readiness review. It is not a certification of readiness.

1. Delivery dependencies
The equipment arrival date is provisional. A draft schedule indicates Tuesday delivery, but the source capture does not contain a confirmation. Treat this date as planning context.

2. Ownership
The presentation owner remains unresolved. Maya requested an updated deck; no acceptance appears in the available captured material. Sent-mail coverage is unavailable.

3. Evidence quality
The utilization figures were supplied two days before the current planning note. Two annexes were not present in the delivered document corpus. Older figures remain inspectable with their capture times.

4. Next review
Use the stored calendar occurrence for the scheduled review time. The record does not establish attendance acceptance, recurrence expansion or conflict-free availability.

5. Long-form difficult case
The planning note deliberately contains a long passage to evaluate reading comfort, scrolling, selection, copy, larger text and evidence access. Investigative context should survive a move to a related person or source and a return to this document. Changes in display must never change the underlying source or imply that uncertain assumptions have become facts.

Open questions
Who owns the submission? Which dependency estimates have been validated? Does the upstream schedule contain a later revision?

The answer to these questions is not present in this synthetic capture.
records.rationale: Investigation recipe: stale document with missing annexes and a review within 3 days. This calls for scrutiny, not a conclusion that the document is wrong.
